main.description: Have the directory read the caller's own locallibrary records (computer.localnetwork.dj.set, computer.localnetwork.dj.recording, computer.localnetwork.dj.profile and computer.localnetwork.locallibrary.settings) again from their repo, for records it hasn't indexed yet. Requires inter-service auth; the caller is the issuer. An account's records are read at most every ten minutes, and a call in between answers from the last read.

indexed.description: Whether the directory finished reading them in time. When it didn't, it carries on, and the records show up once it's done.
